column12: EFFECTIVE SEPTEMBER 17, 2024: The government has posted Amendment No. 0002 hereunder this Notice (please refer to the Attachments Section). **EFFECTIVE SEPTEMBER 6, 2024: The government has posted Amendment No. 0001 hereunder this Notice (please refer to the Attachments Section). ** This is a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice for commercial items issued pursuant to FAR Subpart 12. Under this notice, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Chicago District (USACE) is issuing a Request for Quotations (RFQ) for: CHICAGO HARBOR LOCK SECURITY SYSTEM UPGRADE. GOVERNMENT REQUIREMENT: This acquisition is pursuant to the provisions set forth by Part 12 of the Federal Acquisition Regulation, Commercial Items. In this acquisition, the contractor shall supply and deliver Security Cameras and Network Video Recorders for the Chicago Harbor Lock, Chicago, Cook County, Illinois in accordance with the enclosed statement of work. Pricing shall include parts, materials, deliveries, and any incidentals to perform the entire work described in the statement of work. Competition for this acquisition is RESTRICTED TO SMALL BUSINESSES. AN OFFEROR MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE REGISTRATION IN THE SYSTEM FORAWARD MANAGEMENT WHEN PLACING AN OFFER/QUOTATION PACKAGE FORTHIS ACQUISITION. REGISTRATION CAN BE COMPLETED FREE OF CHARGE ATwww.sam.gov. The applicable Size Standard is North American Industry Classification System(NAICS) Code 561621 with a Small Business size standard of $25M. SUBMITTAL DUE DATE AND TIME: The Contractor submittal packages must be received by the USACE-Chicago District Office no later than 1:00 p.m. (Central Time) on September 18, 2024. column12: This announcement constitutes a Request for Proposals (RFP) in accordanxce with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 15 "Contracting by Negotiation". This procurement will be conducted as a partial small business set-aside in accordance with FAR Subpart 19.5. The Government anticpates award of a Multiple Award Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract with a five (5) year period of performance consisting of one base year, four (4) one-year options and one six-month option to extend services. All task orders issued against this IDIQ will be Firm Fixed Price. Award will be made based on the best value to the Government using a subjective tradeoff source selection process. Please note all RFP amendments or other publicly releasable information will reside within this announcement in the Contract Opportunities section of SAM.gov. To be eligible for award, Offeror must be registered in SAM.gov. No paper copes of the RFP will be issued. No paper copies of proposals will be accepted. Offerors are responsible themselves to check SAM.gov for amendments to this RFP. Questions should be addressed to the Primary Point of Contact listed in this announcement, Mr. David A.
